test_assertion.label: unit or integration test assertion failure, including mock verification mismatches
test_assertion.suggested_next_action: Read the failing test and the production call site; decide whether the test or the code is wrong.

compile_or_link.label: compilation, type, or link error
compile_or_link.suggested_next_action: Fix the compile error at its source; do not suppress.

lint_or_format.label: lint, formatting, clippy, or style gate violation
lint_or_format.suggested_next_action: Apply the project's formatter or fix the lint finding at source.

dependency_or_resolution.label: dependency resolution, vendoring, or lockfile failure
dependency_or_resolution.suggested_next_action: Reconcile the vendored dependency and the lockfile; do not add ad-hoc path patches.

timeout_or_resource.label: timeout, out-of-memory, or resource exhaustion
timeout_or_resource.suggested_next_action: Confirm whether the job is genuinely too slow or merely flaky before changing budgets.

gate_or_policy.label: required rule, policy, or review gate not satisfied
gate_or_policy.suggested_next_action: Obtain the missing human sign-off; never self-sign.

infrastructure_or_flake.label: CI infrastructure, runner, or test flakiness
infrastructure_or_flake.suggested_next_action: Re-run to confirm flakiness before changing product code.

score.instructions: How badly does this failure block a green merge for the pull request?
levels: blocker: the job cannot go green without a code change
major: a real defect that must be fixed before merge
